title: Default /reader shows generic corpus-empty UI with no chips or filter rail (expected for no data)
observation:
Production GET /reader (1440x900 inferred via fetch+HTML) renders identical empty state regardless of params:
containing

No prepared article corpus

, p.small-note with 'matching sources', buttons 'Browse sources' + 'Load live sample'. No .activeFilterChips, no h2#article-list, no #reader-search, no desktop rail (xl:sticky). Matches if (corpusEmpty && overlayCount===0) early return. No chips present (pass for 'no chips').
impact: Clean empty desk presentation; filters (forms, chips) not available until live load populates overlay. Query params accepted server-side but not communicated in empty UI.
recommendation: Expose minimal active-filter context or always-render the ReaderFilterRail (desktop) + stub stream so URL-driven filters like q/source_type are visible and adjustable before/without 'Load live sample'. Update empty copy to mention applied filters if any.

title: q=agent: results heading 'Results for “agent”' and Search chip absent (suppressed by empty guard)
observation: /reader?q=agent renders exactly same HTML/text as default (WebFetch+curl confirmed): no 'Results for', no button containing 'Search: agent'. Per code: article-stream h2 uses {query ? `Results for “${query}”` : ...}, chips rendered if activeFilterChips.length>0 (from buildCurrentFilterChips which for query pushes {key:'query', label:`Search: ${state.query}`, overrides:{q:null,cursor:null}} ). Chips + heading only in non-empty branch after ReaderShellHeader. 'Clear chip' (X or Clear all) not present to interact. CurrentState does parse q via useReaderRouteState + parseInitialState. Live sample would send q and render chips once overlay>0 (since guard is && overlayCount===0). No console accessible.
impact: Applied search filter from URL is 'silent' in primary empty/prod state; users lack visual confirmation of active search (chip or heading) until after explicit live load. Reduces discoverability of chip-clearing UX (AUD-CTRL-008,031).
recommendation: Thread currentState.query (and other filters) into ReaderCorpusEmpty (or render a 'filtered-empty' variant of stream) so heading shows e.g. 'No prepared matches for “agent”' and a Search chip (or mini version) + Clear is available pre-live. Ensure chip remove updates URL and re-evals.

title: source_type=blog: 'Type: blog' chip and contextual empty absent; form select not visible
observation: /reader?source_type=blog renders identical generic empty (no 'Type: blog', no source type chip button). Code: buildCurrentFilterChips pushes {key:'sourceType', label:`Type: ${state.sourceType}`, overrides:{source_type:null, cursor:null}} when state.sourceType. The ReaderFiltersForm has
impact: Source type filter from deep link / URL not visible or clearable in default prod view. Inconsistent with task expectation to see source type chip. Same guard issue as QV-002.
recommendation: Render filter chips or a 'current filters' summary inside/above ReaderCorpusEmpty when state has sourceType/query etc. Make the mobile/desktop rail mountable independently of corpus state, or lift filter chrome outside the if. Update empty to note 'Limited to blog sources' etc.

title: Corpus-empty early return in workspace hides filter chips/heading/rails for all URL filter variants (QV-002/003)
observation: The guard if (corpusEmpty && overlayCount === 0 && !refreshing) return <ReaderCorpusEmpty/>; lives in ReaderShellWorkspace before the grid that contains both <ReaderFilterRail desktop> and <section> <mobile rail> <ReaderArticleStream activeFilterChips=... >. ReaderShellHeader also after guard. Empty component receives only refresh props, no currentState/query/sourceType/activeChips. On prod (is_empty true from browseArticleCorpus), all variants collapse to same UI. Even though load-live respects filters (candidateFeeds + live q param), the chip UX (click to clear via onFilterChip->updateUrl->router.replace) and results h2 are unreachable without first loading sample. HTML structure from curl confirms single reader-shell empty card, no stream card with border-b p-5 chips area.
impact: Core reader filter affordances (chips for search/source_type per controls AUD-CTRL-008,031; results heading) are data-state gated behind corpus. Deep links with filters look 'unfiltered' until interaction. Affects polish and E2E expectations around filter apply URL sync.
recommendation: Refactor: always render header + rails + stream wrapper; use internal empty states for 'no articles' vs 'no corpus' (with filter context passed down). Or compute chrome/filterSummary even for empty and pass to empty component for contextual rendering + chips (read-only or clearable).

title: Filter form (when visible) uses consistent label+small-note + min-h-12 controls; topic chips are draft (pre-apply) while stream chips are applied
observation: In ReaderFiltersForm (desktop at 1440x900 xl): form.mt-4.space-y-4 > label.space-y-1.5.text-sm > span.small-note + relative Input#reader-search (pl-10 icon) or Select#reader-source-type etc. Bottom: flex.gap-2 > Button[type=submit disabled={!hasPending}] 'Apply filters' + outline 'Reset'. Topic quick chips and selected topic chips (X remove) use draftState; applied state chips live in stream header only (flex.flex-wrap.gap-2, rounded-md border, X icon, + 'Clear all' ghost). Apply does normalize + updateUrl (router.replace no scroll). Matches controls-registry AUD-CTRL-001,003,004,008,025,026,031. No visual diff observed between variants since forms not mounted.
impact: Draft vs applied separation is intentional (previews before URL mutate) but may confuse; clear separation of 'pending' vs 'active chips' good. Spacing generous (min-h-12, py-3, gap-2/3/4) at desktop.
recommendation: Consider adding 'pending changes' indicator near Apply, or auto-apply on some selects for polish. Ensure topic count badges and aria consistent. (nit: observed via code; would verify spacing/alignment in headed 1440x900 once corpus populated).

title: Hub nav split-brain: PRIMARY_HUB_NAV vs FumaDocs baseOptions links
observation: PRIMARY_HUB_NAV includes Home, no GitHub. baseOptions().links omits Home, adds external GitHub. Users see different nav on / vs /docs.
impact: Orientation friction; Home unreachable from docs chrome; GitHub only on docs.
recommendation: Single SSOT nav config consumed by hub header and layout.shared.tsx.

title: Command palette (⌘K) only on (home) layout, absent on /docs
observation: HubProviders + CommandPalette wired in app/(home)/layout.tsx only. Docs layout uses FumaDocs without palette.
impact: Power users lose global jump nav when reading docs.
recommendation: Mount CommandPalette in docs layout or root layout with route-aware items.

title: No hub-visible theme toggle despite theme-manager.ts
observation: useTheme exists for charts; no header/footer toggle on hub routes. Dark mode only via system or programmatic .dark.
impact: Dark-mode reader/docs polish unaudited in CI; user preference not discoverable.
recommendation: Add ThemeToggle to hub shell + docs; snapshot E2E in light/dark.

title: Link color transitions ignore prefers-reduced-motion
observation: global.css applies 150ms color/opacity transition on all anchors without reduced-motion guard.
impact: Minor vestibular/accessibility friction for reduced-motion users.
recommendation: Wrap transitions in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).

title: axe: 0 violations on / and /reader empty shell
observation: axe-playwright on production HTML for / and /reader empty states reports zero violations.
impact: Baseline a11y solid for empty states; full workspace + dark unaudited live.
recommendation: Extend axe matrix to post-live-sample reader and dark theme.

title: Compact layout typed in prefs but no Compact toggle in filter form
observation: ReaderFiltersForm props include layout compact + onLayoutChange; UI only renders Cards and List buttons (LayoutGrid, List icons).
impact: Users cannot discover compact density; URL/prefs path may set compact without UI affordance.
recommendation: Add third layout button or segmented control for Compact.

title: Live refresh always sorts overlay with compareByPublishedDesc
observation: use-reader-live-refresh accepts sort param but .sort(compareByPublishedDesc) hardcoded at lines 107 and 170. sort=oldest URL ignored for live overlay merge.
impact: Sort filter misleading after live load; inconsistent with corpus sort behavior.
recommendation: Use sort-aware comparator from lib/reader sort helpers.

title: Reset/Clear all does not clear feed= URL param
observation: resetDrafts clears q, source_type, topics, verified, reader_view, sort, cursor but not feed.
impact: Users expect Clear all to fully reset workspace; feed-scoped view persists.
recommendation: Include feed: null in resetDrafts or rename control to 'Clear filters'.

title: Mobile 'Filters and view' details summary tap target borderline
observation: When workspace visible, mobile filter rail uses <details> summary; tap area may fall below 44px min on some breakpoints.
impact: Harder to open filters on phone after corpus populated.
recommendation: Increase summary min-height/padding; verify 44×44px hit target.

title: /dashboard and /docs absent from route-stabilization publicRoutes
observation: PRIMARY_HUB_NAV includes Dashboard and Docs but E2E matrix skips them. /offline included; /dashboard and /docs not.
impact: Regressions on hub-adjacent surfaces ship undetected.
recommendation: Add both routes to publicRoutes with stable heading assertions.

title: Home hero CTAs route correctly but reader empty is default prod landing for Reader nav
observation: Home → Reader CTA lands on corpus-empty /reader. Expected for prod but onboarding could set expectations earlier.
impact: First-time users may not understand Load live sample step.
recommendation: Home copy or reader empty cross-link explaining corpus vs live sample.

title: Home → Reader → Preview works after Load live sample
observation: Playwright: 21 articles after live sample, #reader-search present, 0 console errors. Preview flow requires explicit sample load first.
impact: Core reading loop functional post-bootstrap.
recommendation: Auto-suggest or soft-bootstrap live sample on first visit (product decision).

title: Sources catalog → reader?feed= deep link works in E2E; empty corpus still gates UI
observation: E2E covers feed= navigation; prod empty state hides feed chip until overlay populated.
impact: Source-scoped reader links feel broken until live load.
recommendation: Show feed chip in empty/filter summary (depends on FIX-001).

title: Dashboard charts use theme-manager but hub lacks theme toggle for verification
observation: Dashboard loads 200; chart theming tied to useTheme. Dark chart contrast not live-audited.
impact: Analytics readability in dark unknown.
recommendation: Pair dashboard with theme toggle + visual regression.

title: Docs chrome diverges from hub (nav, palette, typography context)
observation: FumaDocs sidebar + baseOptions nav differs from PRIMARY_HUB_NAV hub header on product routes.
impact: Product feels like two apps; breaks editorial unity.
recommendation: Align docs header links + optional shared hub strip.

title: Draft vs applied filter model is sound when workspace visible
observation: Apply filters / Reset pattern, topic draft chips vs stream applied chips — intentional separation per code review.
impact: Good URL-sync architecture once chrome mounts.
recommendation: Add pending-changes indicator near Apply (polish).

title: Keyboard shortcut matrix (16 shortcuts) not live-verified on production
observation: controls-registry lists j/k/m/s/a/v/r/, g-*, Escape, ?, b. Live prod audit did not execute full KB matrix (blocked by empty guard for stream shortcuts).
impact: Power-user affordances may regress silently.
recommendation: E2E keyboard spec post live-sample bootstrap in CI.
